panels.title: Kirishlar — soat bo'yicha (qaysi vaqtda ko'p)
panels.description: accounts_loginlog: kun davomida qaysi soatlarda ko'proq kirishadi.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at)::int AS soat, COUNT(*) AS kirishlar FROM accounts_loginlog WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Kirishlar — hafta kuni bo'yicha (qaysi kunlari ko'p)

targets.rawSql: SELECT trim(to_char(created_at, 'Day')) AS kun, COUNT(*) AS kirishlar FROM accounts_loginlog WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY trim(to_char(created_at, 'Day')), EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM created_at) ORDER BY EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM created_at)

panels.title: Qaytish darajasi (retention %)
panels.description: Kamida 2 xil kunda kirgan foydalanuvchilar ulushi — bir marta kirgan odam yana qaytdimi.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS retention FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT created_at::date) AS d FROM accounts_loginlog GROUP BY user_id) t

panels.title: Qaytgan vs bir martalik foydalanuvchilar
panels.description: Kamida 2 xil kunda kirgan (qaytgan) va faqat 1 kun kirgan (bir martalik) foydalanuvchilar soni.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d > 1) AS "Qaytgan", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d = 1) AS "Bir martalik" FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT created_at::date) AS d FROM accounts_loginlog GROUP BY user_id) t

panels.title: Kunlik kirishlar (oxirgi 30 kun)
panels.description: Har kungi kirishlar soni — umumiy aktivlik trendi.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS kirishlar FROM accounts_loginlog WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
